study.source: Open Wine Atlas Study, Piemonte lesson
study.soils: West around La Morra and Barolo: younger Tortonian marls, more perfumed wines. East around Serralunga and Monforte: older Helvetian soils with more sandstone, firmer, more structured wines.
study.langhe: Langhe are the hills south of the Tanaro around Alba; Roero north of the river, sandier.
study.nebbiolo: buds early, ripens late; pale, high acidity and tannin, rose and tar aromas; name said to come from nebbia, fog.
